title: OPS — /deliver-next: send top unposted video mp4 as Telegram file
description: Gate urgency: 2/30 posts. /deliver-next sends the actual mp4 file to Telegram chat so operator can save to camera roll and post to TikTok directly from phone. No need to find file path manually.

tasks.title: Add cmdDeliverNext() to cmd-delivery.ts + register /deliver-next in telegram-bot.ts
tasks.description: cmdDeliverNext(chatId): picks top unposted video (by viral_score from auto-delivered.jsonl, excluding dry-run posts), sends caption text message + sendVideoFile() to Telegram. Registered as /deliver-next in async dispatch section.
